chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Aba ʿAbdillah عليه السلام about the minimum of the takbirs in the salat (prayer).
He said: “Three takbirs. Then if there is recitation, you recite with
And if you are an Imam, it suffices you to pronounce one takbir aloud and say six quietly.”

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرِ: the utterance of Allahu akbar within the prayer
key_terms.ثَلَاثُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ: the minimum stated number of takbirs

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum number of takbirs in salat (prayer), and how should an Imam recite them?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the minimum takbir required in salat (prayer) and mentions a concise form of recitation. It also explains a dispensation for the Imam, who may say one takbir aloud and six quietly, indicating practical guidance in the form of the prayer.
